game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Integration Heist: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Camel Trail.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: In Camel Trail, repeat each round: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Camel Trail. Each round, scarab swarms strike the caravan wagon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the heist value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the caravan wagon from scarab swarms in Camel Trail: keep the heist meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: heist drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Integration Heist
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Integration Heist' (Week 9 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Camel Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how heist changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Camel Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 67 seconds while heist > 0.
